gap: No result ChatGPT got lists FOPO's 15.3-inch 1920×1200 triple extender (S980), which is $599.99 on FOPO's US store on 2026-11-21. The 15.6-inch triples priced on the rival pages I opened (Macsecor S6, APILDELLA 15.6", TUTT P7 Pro, ZUMWALT P7) are all 1920×1080.
standout_why: I compared against UPERFECT's '8 Best Triple Screen Laptop Extenders in 2026' (cited in chat 2), iTechGuides' '15 Best Laptop Screen Extenders for 2026', Macsecor's 15.6" Triple Screen Extender page and APILDELLA's storefront. None of them lists a 15–15.6-inch extender with 1920×1200 panels. Every 15.6-inch model they list is 1920×1080. The only 15-inch-class 1920×1200 models ChatGPT found were the Hyangin Z3 (Newegg, cited) and the NGTeco 15.3", and no result mentions the FOPO S980. The S788 page and our 16-inch page cover only 16-inch FOPO models. I could not open Newegg (403), deskfinds (403) or the FOPO S788 page (FOPO's store returned 429 throughout).
decides: If the shopper means 15-inch-class screens, the rival pages give only 1080p models at 15.6", plus the Hyangin Z3 and NGTeco. The FOPO S980 (15.3", 1920×1200) is the maker-store option and belongs in the top three for that reading. If the shopper means a 15-inch laptop, FOPO says the S788 (3×16", 1920×1200) fits 12–18.5-inch laptops (from our record). The S9G and S11 (2×16", 1920×1200) are the two-screen picks. The video path and screen count I could not confirm (see unsourced) decide whether the S980 or a 16-inch FOPO wins.
